about: The docs sections in the oracle's menu order (PLAN.md File tree; ids from docs/research/02 §1). Each section's content is site/docs/sections/<id>.html. title: the section's heading (its h1); label: its menu link (HTML); description: the oracle's head description. Used only until Phase 3 (build.mjs header comment, step 3): route (the old route path), routeTitle (that route's <title> before " • femto" when it is not the title), toc: false (the route's <main> has no has-table-of-contents class), styles (the route's stylesheets after the docs stylesheets: femto's colors on /docs/colors and the version picker routes, then a femto theme on each color route), and variants (the version picker's color routes, each with its own head values, stylesheets and section file site/docs/sections/<id>/<color>.html).
